learning.title: Activate an agent version through POST /v1/agents/:id/activations; only the pricing snapshot is an operator step
learning.trigger: A real-host proof or a production organization needs a `coordinator` or coding agent with an active version and a trusted pricing snapshot.
learning.mistake: The original task-conversation instructions said to activate a version with `PATCH /v1/agents/:id`. `DefinitionUpdate` accepts only name, description and enabled, so the call fails 400 `unrecognized_keys`; the E06 live proof then set `agent_definitions.active_version_id` with database-owner SQL because no route existed. A turn with no active version fails `coordinator_unconfigured`.
learning.rule: Create the agent and version with `POST /v1/agents` and `POST /v1/agents/:id/versions`, then activate with `POST /v1/agents/:id/activations` (Admin, `Idempotency-Key` and `If-Match` with the definition's current version, body `{versionId}`). Never write `active_version_id` as the database owner. `provider_pricing_snapshots` stays server authority that `bakery_app` only reads, so the pricing row is the one operator step; do it only on the per-worktree stack in a proof, and record it.

verification.requirement: tests/integration/manage-immutable-agent-definitions_test.ts covers the activation route. The coordinator agent version config needs harness claude_code, allowedCapabilities [model] and a billing object with billingRoute subscription, backed by an installation budget policy and the operator-inserted pricing snapshot whose provider, billingAccountId, model, pricing_metadata_snapshot and billing_type match that config. Without them the turn fails coordinator_budget_unconfigured or coordinator_unconfigured.
